arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo LEADS_OFFLINE_CHECKS_BEGIN
sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
root='/opt/telegram-robot-leads'
checks=[
 ('health',[sys.executable,'-B',root+'/scripts/lead_health.py','--no-pm2']),
 ('hygiene_preview',[sys.executable,'-B',root+'/scripts/project_hygiene.py','--root',root])
]
for label,cmd in checks:
 proc=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
 print('CHECK',label,'EXIT',proc.returncode)
 if proc.returncode:raise SystemExit('CHECK_'+label+'_FAILED')
 obj=json.loads(proc.stdout)
 if label=='health':
  print('HEALTH_STATUS',obj.get('status','UNSPECIFIED'))
  for key in ('runtime','legacy_database_read_only','accounts'):
   part=obj.get(key,{})
   if isinstance(part,dict):
    print('HEALTH',key,'STATUS',part.get('status','UNSPECIFIED'))
    if key=='legacy_database_read_only': print('LEGACY_DB_PRESENT',part.get('present','UNKNOWN'))
 if label=='hygiene_preview':
  print('HYGIENE_STATUS',obj.get('status'))
  print('ELIGIBLE_CACHE_FILES',obj.get('eligible_python_cache_files'))
  print('REMOVED_FILES',obj.get('removed_files'))
print('LEADS_OFFLINE_CHECKS_PASS')
PY
